Priya Nambiar: heads-up ticket #82011 from ClearStream — they received an invoice missing settlement/processing fees and then a follow-up empty invoice with a payment_ref showing. customer alarmed. cc @Ethan
Ethan Cole: can you paste the invoice ids?
Priya Nambiar: inv_20260715_cs_main and inv_20260715_cs_retry
Maya Jensen: quick symptom: first invoice lacked the settlement fee line (~$18.75), second invoice arrived with zero lines but PDF showed a partial payment_ref token.
Carlos Mendez: grabbing logs now. looks like our outbound settlement callback (to payment gateway) returned 500 mid-pipeline, billing runner marked invoice as "complete" without settlement lines then retried. retry produced empty invoice with placeholder payment_ref.
Ethan Cole: paste log snippet: ```WARN 2026-07-15T12:59:58Z billing: start acct=clearstream id=acct_707 key=2026-07-15
INFO 2026-07-15T12:59:59Z settlement-callback: request -> gateway POST /settle  -> 500
WARN 2026-07-15T12:59:59Z billing: settlement missing -> proceeding (fail-open)
INFO 2026-07-15T12:59:59Z billing: invoice-complete invoice_id=inv_20260715_cs_main lines=[compute:1200.00, vat:240.00] total=1440.00
ERROR 2026-07-15T12:59:59Z emailer: pdf-gen attached ephemeral payment_ref=pay_ref_***_c9f -> redaction attempted
INFO 2026-07-15T13:00:05Z billing: retry triggered reason=settlement-callback-err
INFO 2026-07-15T13:00:06Z billing: invoice-complete invoice_id=inv_20260715_cs_retry lines=[] total=0.00
WARN 2026-07-15T13:00:06Z billing: duplicate invoice created invoice_id=inv_20260715_cs_retry original=inv_20260715_cs_main```
Priya Nambiar: so two issues: 1) fail-open allowed invoice to complete without settlement fee line; 2) retry path created empty invoice and we leaked a partial pay_ref in the PDF/email pipeline.
Maya Jensen: agree. immediate remediation: pause outbound invoice emails for this invoice_key, issue a corrected invoice that includes the settlement fee, void the empty retry invoice and credit any visible phantom charge, and scrub the partial pay_ref from email archives.
Carlos Mendez: tech remediation: 1) change fail-open to fail-safe (do not finalize without settlement lines when settlement is required), 2) make retry path reuse the original invoice payload if content mismatch detected instead of building empty invoice, 3) ensure redaction runs on retry pipelines too (PR billing/fix-settlement-gate #1176).
SettlementBot: Automated alert: settlement-callback v3 reported failure for acct_707 at 2026-07-15T12:59:59Z. Monitoring enabled for 72h.
Ethan Cole: finance: can we approve credit/void for the retry invoice and reissue correct invoice including settlement fee (~$18.75)? Also need audit log and customer-facing note.
Priya Nambiar: finance approves credit for the retry invoice and replacement invoice. legal to review wording for token exposure. add audit entry: "Replaced duplicate empty invoice; settlement callback failed during initial run; redaction gap addressed."
Maya Jensen: I'm running a dry-run on branch fix/settlement-gate (redacting ids). preview: ```invoice_preview: {account: acct_707, period: 2026-07-01..2026-07-15, lines: [compute: $1200.00, vat: $240.00, settlement-processing: $18.75], total: $1458.75}```
Carlos Mendez: created PR #1176 with tests that stub gateway 500 responses and assert we don't finalize incomplete invoices. will patch pdf redaction to run in retry path too.
Ethan Cole: customer comms: I'll send apology, replacement invoice and a credit note explaining no duplicate charge applied. keep wording high-level: "processing inconsistency" and avoid gateway internals. looping legal.
Priya Nambiar: tracking in ticket#82011. add postmortem item: ensure invoice dedupe compares line-signature and that email pipeline redaction executes deterministically on retry.
SettlementBot: Monitoring active for acct_707 for 72 hours. will alert #finance and #eng-billing on any further duplicate-key or zero-line invoices.
